profile.description:
MiMo V2.6 Flash is Xiaomi's low-cost reasoning model for high-frequency and large-scale workloads. It accepts text, image, and video input with a 1M token context, and supports reasoning, function calling, and native web search.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
